scope: Independent read-only final source review plus specifically authorized extracted-function/stubbed-shell identity checks. No repository edits, Cargo/builds, QEMU, real signals, host proc writes, host USB/module/network mutation or actual integration by reviewer.

reviewed_points.name: isolation
reviewed_points.finding: Guest requires PID1, RUSTUSB_QEMU_GUEST=1 and explicit rustusb.crash_test=1 before mounting and module/device operations. Runner requires ordinary host UID/x86_64, creates private socketpair networking, temporary initramfs/QMP/FTDI Unix sockets and no host USB control.

reviewed_points.name: source_provenance
reviewed_points.finding: Runner records script/lock/product fingerprint, build argv and release ELF identity, guest ELF equality, utility/module/kernel/initramfs provenance, and explicit post source/binary/commit guards. Reviewer did not execute these operations.

reviewed_points.name: machine_channel
reviewed_points.finding: Separate ttyS1 program evidence and ttyS0 kernel console. Exact delimited JSON parsing neither removes ANSI nor rewrites data. Integrity and guest FAIL are searched in both channels.

reviewed_points.name: identity
reviewed_points.finding: Before KILL, server_identity verifies actual executable, PID start time, all four UIDs and effective/permitted/ambient capabilities, and per-device proc-FD node identity. All failed checks propagate explicitly, including when called under if during restart.

reviewed_points.name: signal_target
reviewed_points.finding: One source-level UID1000 KILL command targets the exact initial owned child PID after identity/claim/pending observations; no broad process matching or helper signal. stdin FIFO is retained by init, so initial EOF/shutdown is not the trigger.

reviewed_points.name: initial_baseline
reviewed_points.finding: Original sysfs is separately copied before service operation. Baseline, held and pre-crash evidence retain initial snapshot and independent generation/config/alt/driver/root0600/node identity. Later epochs do not overwrite the saved initial baseline.

reviewed_points.name: real_io_and_claims
reviewed_points.finding: Initial client attaches actual HID/FTDI through helper/VHCI, confirms same receipts and native usbhid/ftdi_sio, real KEY1 down/up and exact 35B RX/TX, then server checks real leased/pending/inflight/budget and independent usbfs claims before KILL.

reviewed_points.name: wait_and_absence
reviewed_points.finding: wait uses an explicit if/else preserving actual signal exit status; wait137 is checked as a process fact rather than requiring graceful exit0. Killed epoch has no invented stopped event, final snapshot or terminal/reap counters.

reviewed_points.name: bounded_observation
reviewed_points.finding: Guest uses elapsed-time deadlines for initial server/client observation and restart startup/shutdown. Unrestored initial state is collected to the observation deadline; elapsed and actual flags are retained. Host has an overall bounded integration deadline and failure grace, followed by owned-QEMU reap.

reviewed_points.name: client_before_detach
reviewed_points.finding: Client records sessions, old-generation absence and raw VHCI status before any detach. Held readers persist through crash observation. Cache detach is later and failures set PASS=false while continuing final handshake.

reviewed_points.name: both_primary_before_restart
reviewed_points.finding: Server persists initial events/stderr/outcome before primary-server-observed; client persists its outcome before primary-client-observed. This barrier completes both primary observations before server launches exactly one restart.

reviewed_points.name: one_restart_no_import
reviewed_points.finding: Only one launch_server restart call. Client issues no post-crash attach/IMPORT and waits through restart. Restart-ready/refused/timeout are separate labels and raw events/stderr/outcome; ordinary cooperative shutdown is attempted only after verified ready identity.

reviewed_points.name: different_epochs
reviewed_points.finding: Verifier holds initial_events, restart_events and observations separately, with exactly one restart observation label. It never substitutes a fresh registry zero snapshot for killed-epoch cleanup.

reviewed_points.name: wrong_fresh_baseline_rejected
reviewed_points.finding: Fresh ready device-ID set must exactly match the two initial IDs; original/current drivers are compared by device_id to initial baseline, plus independent initial sysfs equality. New-epoch cleanup_verified=true or zero counters do not satisfy old restoration if drivers changed to None.

reviewed_points.name: restart_refusal_preserved
reviewed_points.finding: Empty restart event block/refusal/timeout remains parseable observational evidence without fabricated ready. Recovery checks still fail, and raw stderr/actual wait/null are preserved; no retry is launched.

reviewed_points.name: collection_vs_recovery
reviewed_points.finding: Both COLLECTION_COMPLETE markers are recorded separately from every fact/recovery check. The default result stays FAIL; any failed check, observed failure_started, wrong TX/injection set or nonzero guest exit prevents PASS. Expected negative recovery is not relabelled PASS by evidence completion or guest poweroff0.

reviewed_points.name: raw_payload_preservation
reviewed_points.finding: Host collector saves the actual synthetic FTDI TX bytes as ftdi-host-tx.bin in finally and separately records bytes/digest/exact-match. Client includes evdev and RX hex/receipt/VHCI evidence for independent decoding; these are harness-only fixed fixture data.

reviewed_points.name: scope
reviewed_points.finding: Exactly the two new scripts reviewed; existing product, dependency, helper, native and prior QEMU harness files are not changed by reviewer. No guardian/lease guard/automatic restore/TLS/hardware claim is introduced.

resolved_review_findings.issue: POSIX/ash conditional function invocation suppresses errexit inside its body. Original restart if server_identity could mask an early identity rejection with later successful jq.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: ordinary_identity and server_identity now explicitly return on every required identity/FD/stat/jq failure; exact frozen guest matches targeted test source.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Final acceptance should explicitly retain an earlier observed host failure rather than rely only on final appended-log inspection.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Final main condition includes failure_started is not None; default summary FAIL and verification failures remain rejecting.

resolved_review_findings.issue: Fresh device order must not determine the original-driver comparison.
resolved_review_findings.resolution: Verifier checks len2 plus exact initial device-ID set and uses original_by_id for fresh driver mapping.

targeted_identity_validation.cases: 8 ordinary identity checks, 6 server identity/FD/stat/jq failure propagation cases, 1 explicitly derived no-return fault variant proving conditional-call false success.
targeted_identity_validation.provenance_note: The separately preserved file named negative-before captured an already-fixed revision during concurrent authoring; it says NOT_REPRODUCED. No old raw source archive is claimed. Faulty negative here is explicitly derived by removing explicit returns from the actual extracted fixed function.

author_static_validation.scope: Author-reported syntax/jq and synthetic parser validation; not an independent QEMU result and not duplicated by this reviewer.

limitations: All before/after guards, real pending USBFS, exact I/O, SIGKILL wait137, timed sysfs behavior, client auto-NULL, first restart accepted/refused, and final product recovery verdict remain to be established by the actual root-owned integration run.
No unavailable killed-epoch terminal/USBFS reap/budget result is inferred.

A no-must-fix source review permits the bounded negative experiment; it does not establish correctness of a future recovery guard or close hardware G1/G2, kernel-internal-blocking, storage, supervisor/helper-crash or Phase3 gates.

The first tiny extraction file named negative-before actually captured the concurrently repaired source and reports NOT_REPRODUCED. It is not a captured old failing source; the later faulty variant is explicitly derived.
